user_query: trass gmail with term mgm or shipbob or merchant or support last 1 month

intent.goal: find gmail messages in trass workspace containing MGM, ShipBob, merchant or support mentions

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    g.subject,
    g.sender_name,
    g.sender_email,
    g.message_content,
    g.email_date
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND datetime(u.created_time) >= datetime('now', '-1 month')
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%mgm%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%' OR
    g.subject LIKE '%shipbob%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%shipbob%' OR 
    g.subject LIKE '%merchant%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%merchant%' OR
    g.subject LIKE '%support%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%support%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200
